quality: Complete, coherently framed stylized asset in both desktop/mobile closed/open captures; no obvious gross missing geometry or clipping.

Existing technical passes are contextual, not fresh visual approval.
decision: Hold for an explicit fidelity decision on pale marketing versus saturated wood-like runtime finish. Preserve this significant gap; do not silently downgrade it to ordinary polish. No art changes or final user approval.

decision: Pass only as the bounded stylized candidate with disclosed material and foliage limitations; no substantial silhouette/theme discrepancy found against supplied marketing. Not final user approval or photoreal/reference equivalence.
